spans.s: वृद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा; compar. ज्यायस् or वर्षीयस्; super. ज्येष्ठ or वर्षिष्ठ) 1. Increased, augmented; 2. full-grown; 8. old, aged, advanced in years, Bg.i.12, R.xii.20; 4. great, large; 5. accumulated, heaped; 6. wise, learned.
वृद्ध (II) m. 1. An old man, भूमिपतिं शशाप हस्तार्पितैर्नयनवारिभिरेव वृद्धः R.ix.78, Megh.i.30; 2. a sage, a saint; 3. a male descendant.
वृद्ध (III) n. Benzoin.

वृद्ध (I) a. (f. द्धा; compar. ज्यायस् or वर्षीयस्; super. ज्येष्ठ or वर्षिष्ठ) 1. Increased, augmented; 2. full-grown; 8. old, aged, advanced in years, Bg.i.12, R.xii.20; 4. great, large; 5. accumulated, heaped; 6. wise, learned.
वृद्धा f. 1. An old woman; 2. a female descendant.
वृद्ध-अंगुलि f. 1. the thumb; 2. the great toe.
वृद्ध-अंगुष्ठ m. 1. the thumb; 2. the great toe.
वृद्ध-अवस्था f. old age.
वृद्ध-आचार m. ancient custom.
वृद्ध-उक्ष m. an old bull.
वृद्ध-काक m. a raven.
वृद्ध-नाभि a. corpulent, pot-bellied.
वृद्ध-भाव m. old age.
वृद्ध-वाहन m. the mango tree.
वृद्ध-श्रवस् m. an epithet of Indra.
वृद्ध-सूत्रक n. a flock of cotton.

वृद्धि f. 1. Increase, augmentation, growth, पुपाष वृद्धिं हरिदश्वदीधितेरनुप्रवेशादिव बालचंद्रमाः R.iii.22; 2. increase of the digits of the moon, कलाक्षयः श्लाग्यतरो हि वृद्धेः R.v.16, K.S.v.1; 3. a heap, a quantity, a multitude; 4. success, prosperity, advancement, परिवृद्धिमत्सरि मनो हि मानिनाम् Sis.xv.1.; 5. wealth, property; 6. profit, gain; 7. interest, usury; 8. enlargement of the scrotum; 9. extension of power or revenue (in politics); 10. the lengthening of a vowel, the substitution of आ, ए, ओ, आर् and आल् for अ, इ, उ, ऋ and ऌ (short or long) (in gram.).
वृद्धि-आजीव, आजीविन् m. a money-lender, a usurer.
वृद्धि-आजीव, आजीविन् m. a money-lender, a usurer.
वृद्धि-जीवन n. the profession of usury.
वृद्धि-जीविका f. the profession of usury.
वृद्धि-पत्र n. a kind of razor.
वृद्धि-श्राद्ध n. an offering made to the deceased ancestors on any prosperous occasion.
